socket.description: The path to the VDE switch management socket. This must match the -M option specified in the vde_switch invocation.

nodename.description: The display name for the switch in telnet/web interfaces. If not provided, the system hostname is used.

switch_config.description: A list of VDE switch configuration commands to apply on startup. These correspond to the interactive commands available in the vdetelweb session but applied automatically from the rcfile. Common commands include 'set', 'addacl', 'delacl', etc. Refer to vde_switch documentation for valid syntax.
